clauses.quote: Fines, damages, penalties, or forfeitures shall not be paid by the Board.
Civil liability insurance coverage shall be provided for each teacher.
Costs of this coverage shall be paid by the Board.
the teacher shall be paid their full salary for the period of such absence not to exceed 180 contract days
such paid absence shall in no event be deducted from any sick or personal leave to which such teacher is entitled.
The Board agrees to reimburse the teacher the market value of any personal property damaged or destroyed as a result of assault suffered in connection with the teacher’s employment.

Time lost by a teacher for appearance before a judicial body or legal authority related to an assault case directly connected with employment as a teacher in the District, shall result in no loss of wages or reduction in accumulated leave.
clauses.subject_text: Time lost by a teacher for appearance before a judicial body or legal authority related to an assault case directly connected with employment as a teacher in the District
clauses.notes: Imposes administrative duty to preserve wages/leave for court appearances

clauses.quote: Teachers will be evaluated under the provisions of the Utah Administrative code 53G.
Copies of all formative and summative teacher evaluations will be given to the teacher for their personal file.
clauses.subject_text: Copies of all formative and summative teacher evaluations

clauses.quote: The teacher shall have the right to attach or submit an explanation, or other written statement regarding any formative or summative evaluation, for inclusion in the teacher’s file.
Summative evaluations, or formative evaluations which could lead to corrective discipline or non-renewal, shall only be conducted by fully licensed administrative personnel.
clauses.subject_text: Summative evaluations, or formative evaluations which could lead to corrective discipline or non-renewal

clauses.quote: Materials from files kept in a school shall be used primarily for the improvement of a teacher's performance.
clauses.subject_text: Materials from files kept in a school
